hook.say: Most of our planet is covered by water. How well do you know it? Five questions, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which ocean lies between Africa and Australia?
questions.fact: The Indian Ocean is the third largest ocean, and the warmest.
questions.sayAnswer: The Indian Ocean! It is the third largest ocean, and the warmest.

questions.q: Which is the smallest ocean in the world?
questions.fact: The Arctic is also the shallowest of the world's 5 oceans.
questions.sayAnswer: The Arctic! It is also the shallowest of the world's 5 oceans.

questions.q: Which canal links the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea?
questions.fact: The Suez Canal opened in 1869 and runs 193 km through Egypt.
questions.sayAnswer: The Suez Canal! It opened in 1869, and runs 193 kilometers through Egypt.

questions.q: Which strait separates Europe from Africa?
questions.fact: At its narrowest, Spain and Morocco are less than 15 km apart.
questions.sayAnswer: The Strait of Gibraltar! At its narrowest point, Spain and Morocco are less than 15 kilometers apart.

questions.q: Which is the only sea on Earth without a land boundary?
questions.fact: The Sargasso Sea is bordered by four Atlantic currents, not by land.
questions.sayAnswer: The Sargasso Sea! It is bordered by four Atlantic Ocean currents, not by land.
